shared.state: Exclusive exact-union|null controlled value or mount-only defaultValue. Controlled owner authoritative; release retains latest committed value. Existing fixed-value scalar owner reused without changes. No hidden fields; native form reset does not change tab selection.
shared.keyboard: All4 default vertical per originals; caller may override horizontal/vertical, ltr/rtl and loop. Automatic activation on focus or manual arrows-only then Enter/Space/click. Home/End all eligible items. Native Tab. Actual DOM availability/fieldset/CSS/hidden/inert/closed containers respected, modified/composition events ignored.
shared.lifecycle: Associated hidden panels persist; inactive contents and actions unmount. Conditional return focus only while closing panel remains hidden and no explicit external focus; reopening invalidates stale return, and internal return never reselects. React19 cleanup refs supported. Latest owner, canceled event and unmount supersede deferred work.
shared.actions: Only18/19 accept exact per-value per-action native actionProps and onAction(action,details). Native onClick first, notification after propagation if uncanceled/current owner/available. Snapshot before caller. Noncontrolled logical already-accepted selection invalidates old panel intent before commit; controlled rejected proposal does not. Committed disable-reenable invalidates old action. onAction return ignored, no default external operation or fake success. Root/per-action disabled applies; disabled nav tab alone does not disable active panel action. Native action keyboard only; never submit.
shared.tooltip: Only21 exposes separate exact-union|null tooltipProps owner/defaultValue, disabled, finite nonnegative delayDuration(default0), onValueChange with pointer/focus/leave/blur/escape/press reasons and cancel/false/event-prevention veto. Shared30 controller preserves capture owner stamps, callback key veto, overlapped method restoration, pending timers canceled on actual disabledness, harmless style/class changes retained. Pointer/focus open, blur/leave close unless still hovered/focused, click/pointerdown/Enter/Space dismiss, Escape dismisses; same press does not reopen on focus. Tooltip remains hoverable, no interactive content. Root-contained right positioning; no portal/collision/arrow-geometry equivalence. Tooltip owner does not change selection and selection owner does not force tooltip owner. Escape ownership is fixed in document capture: innermost containing tooltip root first, then active-focus root, then most recently engaged available owner, then a sole available open/pending owner. Ambiguous externally targeted Escape with multiple unengaged controlled tips has no target. Refusal/cancellation/unmount of the chosen owner never redirects that same event to another instance. This is a148 authorized backward repair for07 and new21;144 frozen artifacts remain unchanged. Pending Escape candidates must have a current epoch/ticket, uncanceled event guard and an opening pointer/focus reason. No-op press/leave/blur is not an opening. Owner handoff invalidates old pending work without erasing the first new-epoch focus request, including delayed focus. Pending opening also predicts a non-null intended value without mutating interaction refs; an Escape-blocked repeated hover or same-press no-op focus is not treated as an opener merely because of its event reason.
shared.a11y: Unique reciprocal tab/panel relationships, roving focus; decorative SVGs hidden.21 icon-only buttons have meaningful default accessible names even when tooltip closed, aria-describedby combines caller and shown tooltip IDs.18 visible counts remain readable.20 progress is explicitly illustrative, not fake live media. Fixed text/type/id/role protected; native attrs/ref available.
shared.style: Each ID retains original distinct visual grammar and full content. Scoped responsive/dark/reduced-motion/forced-color CSS, no external fonts/images. Panels, actions, tooltip and progress are constituent parts, not new IDs.
